extracted.summary: A solicitor at Ueda Family Law seeks around £21,500 to fund her client's costs to FDR in financial remedy proceedings at the Family Court at Birmingham, where matrimonial assets are about £478,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. To take this further we would need confirmation of your client's identity and address details, a breakdown of the £21,500 costs estimate, details of the matrimonial assets and any supporting valuations (including the family home and the husband's business interest), and confirmation of the procedural position including any listed hearing dates. It would also help to have details of any existing charges or encumbrances on the assets in dispute and your firm's client care documentation. Once we have reviewed that information, a member of our team will come back to you. Nothing in this message constitutes an offer of finance or an indication of terms.
